description: Wait for somebody else to change a design and return what they changed, rather than asking again whether they have. Returns the moment a designer in the browser or another agent commits an edit, as the same update frame the browser's own live socket receives; returns a `timedOut` reply if nothing happens within `waitSeconds`, which you answer by calling again with the same cursor. Quote as `afterSequence` the `throughSequence` of the delta you last received, or the `lastSequence` of the last snapshot; a cursor the server no longer retains is answered with a whole snapshot instead of the operations you missed. `waitSeconds: 0` checks without blocking. Nothing is lost between calls — the cursor is replayed when you call again — so somebody merely looking at the design does not wake you, and only a committed change does.

afterSequence.description: The `lastSequence` you last saw, from ui_builder_get_design or a previous wait.

agentModel.description: Optional current model name shown to design viewers; self-reported. Omit when unknown.

agentName.description: Optional agent/client name shown to design viewers; self-reported.

includeCatalog.description: When the reply is a whole snapshot, embed the pinned catalog in it. Defaults to false.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

name: ui_builder_await_design
